blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Mouse 4 no longer controls backwards menu navigation to prevent conflicts with other functions that might be bound to that button
- Fixed a bug preventing audio from mixing correctly on the main menu screen

blocks.title: Competitive Play
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that sometimes allowed Symmetra to place Teleporters and Shield Generators inside her teams spawn room in a competitive match

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that allowed Sombra to permanently hack a health pack
